title: Raycast key features
description: A statement on the left (white claim, grey follow-up, the light button) beside a huge dark keyboard that runs off the right edge; four of its keys are feature tiles (icon, bold lead, grey line) that fade up from 20% as they scroll into view while the plain keys stay dim. On phones the keyboard sits above the statement and fades into it.
notes: the tiles are keys of the keyboard component: pass them in `keys`
the button shows from desktop width, as in the original
name: raycast-key-features

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: ReactNode; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }

props.name: keys
props.description: the keyboard rows; keys with a `tile` become feature tiles that fade in on scroll
